niche_preference_profile: This user most often prefers interfaces that feel clean, spacious, and clearly structured, with strong hierarchy, restrained visual noise, and polished but not flashy styling. They frequently favor light backgrounds with dark text for readability, though in some app-like or immersive contexts they also respond well to dark navy/near-black themes when contrast is strong and the layout stays minimal. They like rounded, softened controls and cards, concise but well-organized content, clear primary actions, and calm, refined presentations over busy, promotional, cluttered, or overly decorative ones.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers layouts with more whitespace, breathing room, fewer competing elements, less overlay/decorative clutter, and cleaner uninterrupted composition.
Prefers strong structure and hierarchy: clearly separated sections, centered or focused compositions, title-first organization, distinct labels, and obvious focal points.
Prefers gentle, refined, approachable, polished, clinical, or reassuring presentation over flashy, gaming-like, promotional, utilitarian, or dramatic styling.
Prefers highly legible interfaces with strong text contrast, clearer separation of content, and backgrounds that support readability rather than low-contrast presentation.
Prefers pill-shaped or softly rounded buttons, cards, filters, and modal surfaces rather than sharper rectangular treatments.
Prefers a single obvious primary CTA with stronger emphasis, while secondary actions are subdued and do not compete for attention.
Prefers shorter, grouped, summarized, or simplified content when it improves scannability, while still maintaining useful structure and organization.
